<!-- pr-reviewer: ef0d502da087de05b59175ccc46877f8719d17bf -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The case meets #2874. It includes an original model, its generator, the script, the portable project, the NC program, and the README.
The project keeps Probe before Face. The script uses commands and checks verification before it posts.

Local results against upstream/main `d911f45535df24c42d5fde5feaed386c5fca4907`:

- The trial merge was clean. The PR already contains this main commit.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. The `example_catalog` suite had 37 passes and four ignored tests.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: passed. The release build passed. This review ran `app heavy: example_catalog`: four passes.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask catalog --check`: passed for all 14 cases.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: passed. The worktree has no tracked changes.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render`, from `crates/ui`: two passes. The screenshot renderer stayed ignored.
- The full `example_catalog` suite ran in the quick gate. These suites read the changed catalog directory.
- No importer code or STEP fixture changed. The extra importer suites do not apply.

Safety checks:

- This is a safety-tier review because the PR adds geometry and an NC golden. No production algorithm or guard changed.
- I read all 82 NC lines. The fast and slow G31 touches, contact checks, tolerance check, and G54 update precede Face1.
- Face1 uses tool 2 and cuts at Z12. Its passes cover the 100 x 60 mm stock with the 10 mm tool.
- No existing NC or CL golden changed.
- I repeated both reported mutations with `catalog_probing_probe_face::probes_before_first_cut`.
- Remove the case: the test failed with `catalog case probing/probe-face is missing`. Restore it: the test passed.
- Remove the G31 lines: the test failed with `the probe cycle must precede the first cut`. Restore them: the test passed.

Requested before merge: none.

No physical machine test ran. No UI source changed, so before/after UI screenshots do not apply.
The author did not run the heavy lane. This review supplies the green local result above.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: ef0d502da087de05b59175ccc46877f8719d17bf -->
Second safety read (Opus, read-only): clean

Scope: head `ef0d502da087de05b59175ccc46877f8719d17bf`, base `main`, not merged. I read the full diff and the full `probe-face.nc`. I did not build. I did not run `cargo xtask catalog --check`, because it builds the full `camcraft-cli` and not only xtask.

**Probe motion (`probe-face.nc`)**
- The rapids stop at the clearance height. `G00 Z38.` and `G00 X0. Y0. Z38.` are 25 mm above the nominal stock top (Z13). No rapid moves toward the part below Z38.
- The approach is a protected move with a hit check:
  - `G31 X0. Y0. Z18. F300`
  - `IF[ABS[#5063-18]GT0.001]THEN#3000=3(PROBE HIT ON POSITIONING)`
- The fast touch has a no-contact alarm, and it goes 1 mm past the nominal surface:
  - `G31 X0. Y0. Z12. F300`
  - `IF[ABS[#5063-12]LT0.001]THEN#3000=2(PROBE NO CONTACT)`
- The probe backs off, and then it does the slow touch:
  - `G91 G01 X0. Y0. Z1. F300`
  - `G31 X0. Y0. Z12. F30`
  - The no-contact alarm follows again.
- The probe retracts before the Face section starts:
  - `G91 G01 X0. Y0. Z5. F300`
  - `G31 X0. Y0. Z38. F300` with the hit check `#3000=3`.
- The probe feeds are F300 (fast) and F30 (slow). They are probe feeds, not the Face cutting feed (F1200). The `G01` moves are short incremental retracts away from the surface (+Z), at the probe feed.
- The spindle is off. `M5` comes after `T01 M6`/`G43 H01` and before the first move. `M5` also comes before the next tool change. No `M3` or `M8` is in the probe section.
- The probe tool (`T01 PRB-0400 - TOUCH PROBE D4 R2`) is not the cutter (`T02 EM-1000-4FL - FLAT END MILL D10`).

**How the Face cut uses the result**
- `#190=#102-13` is the measured top minus the nominal top.
- `IF[ABS[#190]GT0.5]THEN#3000=1(PROBE Z OUT OF TOLERANCE)` stops the program when the error is more than 0.5 mm.
- `G10 L2 P1 Z[#5223+#190]` moves the G54 Z offset by the error. On Fanuc, `#5223` is the G54 Z offset.
- The Face section selects `G54` again (`G90 G54 G40 G49 G80`). Thus `Z12` is 1 mm below the measured stock top. The README and the decision file say this, and they say that the case uses the nominal contact and does not simulate a measured offset.

**Tool change and Face**
- `T02 M6`, `G43 H02` and `S5800 M3` come before the first move. `M8` also comes before it.
- The plunge `G01 X-55. Y-25. Z12. F300` is a feed move outside the stock (X-55, R5 tool, stock edge at X-50).
- The passes are at Z12, which is the model top. The model does not get a gouge. Y±25 with R5 covers the 60 mm stock. The exit is `G00 X-55. Y25. Z38.`, and then `M9`, `M5` and `G28`.

**Shipped files, Clean-Room, metadata**
- The model comes from an original generator (`generate.py`, a 100 x 60 x 12 block) and is embedded in the project. The camproj has no local paths.
- Each new code file has a provenance line. I found no HSMWorks text or asset.
- `case.toml` uses the same keys as `2d/first-part`: `kinds`, `machine` and `expect = "post"`.
- The README text agrees with the posted program: `G31` at F300 and F30, the `G91 G01` retracts, the `G10 L2 P1` update, the tool change, and the Z12 `G01` moves.
- The two site guide pages now list the case. The probing page no longer says "No catalog case yet".
- The PR adds no `.cl` file, and no catalog case on `main` has one. No other golden, `.nc` or `.cl` file changes.

**Notes (not blockers)**
- The PR does not change the post logic. This read checks the posted output, not the post engine.
- The `catalog --check` byte comparison of the `.nc` file did not run in this read.

Coordinator: this PR merges by the maintainer's standing order of 2026-11-21 ("merge using the recommended option"). The reviews that this merge relies on, both on head ef0d502da: mkinney's collaborator marker (clean) and the second Opus safety read (comment 7076095162, clean). Every probe move is a `G31` feed with an alarm check, the rapids stop at Z38, the spindle is off while probing, and the probe result shifts G54 Z through `G10 L2`. `main` is green. I merge it on head ef0d502da. It is a fork PR, so its branch stays.
